name: fix_kotlin_bang_bang_npe
description: Replaces a !! null assertion that crashes on missing keys with a safe fallback
prompts: SettingsStore.getOrDefault in src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/SettingsStore.kt is documented to return `default` when the key is missing, but it uses the `!!` not-null assertion on the map lookup - so a missing key throws NullPointerException (and the `default` parameter is silently ignored even for present keys' fallback path). Fix it using Kotlin's null-safe idioms (the elvis operator `?:`, or Map.getOrDefault) so a present key returns its value and a missing key returns `default`. Keep the class and method signatures.
